rationale: After the insulin types block, test knowledge of rapid-acting analogue onset to reinforce PKD distinctions taught in the block.
After the SGLT2 inhibitor block and the clinical pearl, test the critical eGFR threshold for glycaemic benefit of SGLT2i.
After the anti-resorptive agents block, confirm understanding of the bisphosphonate mechanism and the key adverse effect to monitor.
After the anabolic agents block, test the sequencing rule for teriparatide and subsequent anti-resorptive therapy.
After the hypothyroidism drugs block, confirm understanding of levothyroxine administration timing for optimal absorption.
After the hyperthyroidism drugs block, test the agranulocytosis warning associated with thionamides.
After the drug classification block, test understanding of somatostatin analogues used in acromegaly.
After the per-drug-class PK/PD block, test knowledge of cabergoline superiority over bromocriptine in prolactinoma.
After the pharmacology/mechanisms/PK block, test ranking of glucocorticoids by anti-inflammatory potency.
After the adverse effects block, test the HPA axis suppression rule regarding gradual withdrawal.
After the erectile dysfunction drugs block, test the critical drug interaction and contraindication for PDE5 inhibitors.
After the androgen drugs block, test knowledge that anabolic steroid misuse causes gonadotropin suppression and testicular atrophy.
After the mechanisms/PK/ADRs block, test the absolute contraindication of combined oral contraceptive pills.
After the classification block, test knowledge of the emergency contraception time window.
After the uterine stimulants block, test the drug of choice for active management of the third stage of labour.
After the uterine relaxants block, test the key contraindication for nifedipine tocolysis related to MgSO4.
After the mechanisms/PK/uses block, test the mechanism of clomiphene and its key risk.
After the drug classification block, test that metformin (not a fertility drug per se) improves ovulation in PCOS by reducing insulin resistance.
